                              Book Launch Memo & Key Details

Context:
18 months ago we did the launch that broke the internet. We still ride this goodwill today. But,
it’s time to do another one and re-anchor ourselves as top in the business space.

Confirmed Date: 9:00AM August 16th, 2025.

Objective(s):
Each book is a meta concept. Offers was an offer so good you’d feel stupid saying no. Leads
was a crazy advertising campaign and an offer so good you’d feel stupid saying no. And this
launch uses the skills from offers, leads, and adds in monetization.

It would be iconic to continue the $100M series with a $100M Money Models launch, and break
two Guinness World Records;

        1. Set a new Guinness World Record for the most books sold in 24 hours by a
           single author – targeting over 1.5 million units on Day 1 of release.
        2. Most viewers of a book launch live stream on YouTube, with a current record of
           151,161 concurrent viewers. hosted live in conjunction with the book launch.


Post launch, we kick off aggressive PR about the record breaking launch to reinforce and
memorialize the brand moment.

Project Resources:

   1. Project Owner (Name, Contract)

       Key Responsibilities: Oversee the entire project, manage timelines, coordinate
       between teams (tech, affiliates, ads, media, shipping, PR), and ensure all phases are
       executed on time to facilitate a record breaking launch.

   2. Sales Support Lead (Name, Contract)

       Key Responsibilities: Facilitate and oversee the day of launch sales and ensure
       adequate staffing to handle and maximize sales volume. Source and stand up surge
       sales support staff of 300 reps at peak volume and 125+ during no peak sales hours.

   3. eCommerce StoreOwner (Name)

Ad Spend:
We plan to spend $3M in advertising across Meta, YT, TikTok, and LinkedIn over the course of
5 weeks leading up to launch. We will ramp up spending to $250,000/per day. .

Ad Overview
   ●   We will be using 2 companies to run paid ads.
          ○ Vendor - who ran all the traffic for the last book launch.
                  ■ They will get 80% of advertising budget
          ○ Vendor - Current media buying team.
                  ■ They will get 20% of the advertising budget
          ○ If one is out performing the other we will reallocate the ad budget accordingly
          ○ Both teams are synced and meet weekly to align on strategy.
   ●   We have increased daily spend limits in multiple ad accounts and will continue to
       request this leading up to the launch.
   ●   We have 3 business managers set up as back up redundancies.

How the launch will work:
The launch will go through preparation, email kick off to our list (6 weeks out), Affiliate Kickoff to
our $100M leads Affiliate list (6 weeks out), announcement (4 weeks out), the countdown, the
live launch, a replay/cart close mini event the next morning, announcement of the total sales,
making it available on amazon etc, and kick off of PR campaign.

Venue: Company Headquarters
We will be building an inhouse Virtual event space in Alex's studio. We have ordered an LED
wall that will be set up and configured for the live. We have contracted Vendor studio set up
team to help with LED wall build as well as the onsite AV production of the event.

The virtual live stream will be hosted on three different links on two different platforms
   1. YT Live Non VIP. Comment will be enabled to enhance the viewer experience. We will
        have light moderators in the chat.
   2. VIP YT Live. Comments will be enabled and this will be monitored by Alex to pull VIP
        questions for the mystery guest speakers. This will also be the chat shown on the
        screen.
   3. Zoom. So that we can mimic a crowded group behind Alex, we’ll invite L2 and L3 people
        to the zoom link. A manageable number of people we know are “friendlys” and can
        account for some fall off to showcase the number of faces we want live on the screen.

LED Wall / Studio Setup ≈ Timeline
   1. Vendor will receive the wall in PHX on {Date}

Email copy:     What’s a Money Model?

                A Money Model is a series of offers deliberately structured to generate the
                most cash up front, get the most leads, and get your highest customer lifetime
                value. Period.

                In simpler terms it attracts more customers, gets them to spend more money,
                faster, over and over again.

                It capitalizes on the scientific principles of volume, intensity, latency, frequency
                –but weaponised for growing a business.

                A proper Money Models includes four parts:

                   1) Attraction Offers: to get the most leads

                   2) Upsell Offers: to get more money from them faster

                   3) Downsell Offers: to turn a “no” into a “yes” (even more sales)

                   4) Continuity Offers: to keep them buying again and again

                It took me years to realize this - but every super successful business I’ve
                owned had all four parts perfectly sequenced. The ones that didn’t, weren’t
                super successful, and they were like most businesses…

                Most businesses putter along with only 1 or 2 parts - but - the magic happens
                when you combine all the parts together.

                With a properly designed Money Model…your business attracts the maximum
                amount of customers, maximizes profit and cash flow so you can outspend the
                competition, and builds stability in volatile markets with recurring revenue.

                And the best part, the Money Models in my new book work for any
                business, in any industry, of any size.

                I’ve been waiting for 6 years to unleash the insane power of Money Models -
                and the time has finally come.

                $100M Money Models is coming out on August 16th, 2025.

                courses, or books I've put out over the last few years, this is definitely for
                you:

                Thank you again, Alex

          So…I’m having a book launch. And you’re invited because you trusted me enough to give

could do.
          The book launch is for my next book, $100M Money Models. It’s the book you never
knew you needed. Most businesses lose money advertising because they spend more money getting
customers than they make. The reason is - they don’t know how to get people to spend more money
faster. This book reveals the trade secrets only the pros know - in gritty detail. You’ll be able to grab a
copy at the launch and see the models used in real life. After all, the objective for all business owners is to
make money, not just read about it.
          That being said, I wanted to give you a few reasons to register early (free) and preorder the
book (optional and $29.99)…

Expect fireworks,
Alex

**Attention Business Owners**
             If you’re not a business owner, please ignore this letter and enjoy the playbooks.
One simple process can transform your revenue forever…
         So—there’s a million and one things you hear everyday to grow your business. Post on social
media, get affiliates, run pricing tests, do conversion rate optimization, lower churn, hire more people…
         All while…hopping on and off meetings, endless notifications, new emails, phone calls, sales meetings, personnel
issues…the list goes on forever.
         It makes what should be simple, into a near impossible feat. There’s a reason 95% of
businesses in the US are <$1M in annual revenue. And only .4% (1 in 250) make it past $10M. And
only ~.2% make it over $50M (1 in 500)...it’s hard.
         So no, I have no magic pill for you, but I do have a process that’s helped Leila and I scale our
companies (and get some big exits) over the last 13 years. And I’m gonna show you how it works, and
how to use it, on one piece of paper.

How It Works
      It’s based on a single premise: every business grows until it hits a constraint, then it will grow no further.
Once you relieve the constraint, the business grows again until it hits the next constraint.

Think About It Like This…


        Let’s say you have a four-lane highway that narrows down to one lane. What happens? A traffic
jam. If you add lanes before the bottleneck, what happens? A bigger traffic jam. What happens if you
add lanes after the bottleneck? Traffic still moves at the one-lane speed. In other words, you add
potential to the system, but not throughput. This is what most business owners do. They add capacity
before or after the bottleneck. They work. But nothing grows.
        The only way to get rid of the traffic jam—aka—scale the business—is to add lanes to the one-
lane section. Once you do that, the traffic flows at the “four-lane speed”—think max revenue growth
—until you hit the next bottleneck.

only ~.2% make it over $50M (1 in 500)...it’s hard.
         So no, I have no magic pill for you, but I do have a process that’s helped Leila and I scale our
companies (and get some big exits) over the last 13 years. And I’m gonna show you how it works, and
how to use it, on one piece of paper.

How It Works
      It’s based on a single premise: every business grows until it hits a constraint, then it will grow no further.
Once you relieve the constraint, the business grows again until it hits the next constraint.

Think About It Like This…


        Let’s say you have a four-lane highway that narrows down to one lane. What happens? A traffic
jam. If you add lanes before the bottleneck, what happens? A bigger traffic jam. What happens if you
add lanes after the bottleneck? Traffic still moves at the one-lane speed. In other words, you add
potential to the system, but not throughput. This is what most business owners do. They add capacity
before or after the bottleneck. They work. But nothing grows.
        The only way to get rid of the traffic jam—aka—scale the business—is to add lanes to the one-
lane section. Once you do that, the traffic flows at the “four-lane speed”—think max revenue growth
—until you hit the next bottleneck.

So, the obvious question becomes—how do you make sure what you’re working on is the “one-lane
problem” - aka - the constraint?

How To Figure Out Your Constraint (Your One-Lane Problem)
     1. Ask: “What’s the one thing you do that makes the most money?”
     2. Then ask: “What if I just did 50X more of that?”
     3. When you say you can’t, ask yourself: “Why not?”
    →The answer to that question is the constraint that’s limiting the business.

Easy To Say, Hard To Do
         Let’s say “scaling ads” is the thing that would make you money - BUT - the one thing that
happens is you are no longer profitable when you scale them. That’s the clear symptom, but the root
cause could be: you don’t make enough per customer - or - it costs you too much to get them.
         To figure out which, you’d look at benchmarks for the industry. Let’s say you find out you’re
getting customers for the same price as everyone else…then you’d need to make them worth more:
raise prices, decrease churn, add an upsell/cross sell, or some combination of them all. Alternatively,
let’s say you find it’s costing you too much to get customers. Then you’d need to: fix targeting, make
more ads, make better ads, split test your offer/lead magnet, optimize your click journey for your
customers…or some combination. That’s a lot. So, where do you start?

Where To Start
          “A fool never learns from his mistakes. A smart man learns from his mistakes. A wise man learns from the
mistakes of others” - Some wise philosopher
          This leads us to the only two ways you can solve the problem: 1) trial and error 2) learn from
someone else. To be clear, you’ll figure it out either way. The question is only how much you value
getting there faster.

How I’d Like To Help
        At Acquisition.com all we do is scale companies. We literally look at thousands of companies
every year. We see what works. Where they get stuck. And most importantly, how they get unstuck. If
you’d like to have my team spend two days helping you figure out the constraint to your business and
the most efficient path to solve it…I’d like to invite you to come out to my office in Las Vegas to have
my team of functional experts work on it with you.

too.

embedded_text:
Affiliates Launch — High-Level Breakdown
This is an overview of the parts to the $100M Money Models affiliate program.


1. Email the Main List Twice
Announce the affiliate program and explain rewards and how to participate.
Sub-tasks:

   ●   Email the existing customer list.

   ●   Email the ~29,000 affiliates from the previous $100M Leads launch.


2. Create a YouTube Video
Public video announcing the affiliate program to drive more sign ups.

Usage: Embed on the opt in page and share widely.


3. Define and Promote Prizes
Details:

   ●   Top 50 affiliates: Get an in-person workshop with Alex (Vegas).

   ●   Top 10 affiliates: Get the workshop plus an exclusive in-person dinner with Alex.

   ●   Bonus: Anyone who brings 10 sign-ups gets an automatic chance to win one of 50
       extra workshop spots.


4. Deliver Small Prize for 10 Sign-Ups+
What: Audio book — 70 One-Minute Business Tactics (the Mozi Minutes compiled).
How: Automatic reward plus entry for workshop drawing.
Track who brings whom, ensure proper credit and fair prize distribution.


5. Build the Leaderboard
Display top affiliates in real time to create competition and boost activity. You can do this with
custom code, page builders (Shopify has some) or text-to-code website builders (vibe coding).

The $31 Million Data Collection Project That Changed
Everything

$135,000. Mostly consisting of single day advisory work.

Asking people to fly in, 50 people at a time, using my actual advisors is a wildly inefficient monetization

I did it for only one reason: the data.

entire time period codifying not only the problems - but more importantly - the solutions.

And - I called it - the $100M Money Models Advanced Implementation Playbooks.


What You're Getting: 12 Physical Playbooks That Solve
Everything

other entrepreneurs will get this physical binder with all 12 implementation playbooks…FREE.

Ad #36: Everyone Tells You Hook
Everyone tells you to "increase customer lifetime value" but nobody
actually shows you how to do it.
Here's a step-by-step system you can use today:
Step 1: Map your current customer journey
  ● How do customers find you?
  ● What's the first thing they buy?
  ● What happens after they buy?
  ● When do they usually leave?
Step 2: Find the gaps
  ● Where do customers get confused?
  ● What problems aren't you solving?
  ● What do they need next that you don't offer?
  ● Why do they leave when they leave?
Step 3: Fill the gaps
  ● Create offers that solve the problems you found
  ● Make it easier for customers to understand what you do
  ● Give them logical next steps
  ● Address why they leave
Step 4: Connect the dots
  ● Link your offers together
  ● Make each offer lead naturally to the next
  ● Remove friction between steps
  ● Make saying yes easy
Step 5: Test and improve
  ● Try one change at a time

What’s a Money Model? 

A Money Model is a series of offers deliberately structured to generate the most cash up front, get the most leads, and get your highest customer lifetime value. Period.

In simpler terms it attracts more customers, gets them to spend more money, faster, over and over again.

It capitalizes on the scientific principles of volume, intensity, latency, frequency–but weaponised for growing a business.
A proper Money Models includes four parts:
[List id 140, level 0; label not rendered] Attraction Offers: to get the most leads 

[List id 140, level 0; label not rendered] Upsell Offers: to get more money from them faster

[List id 140, level 0; label not rendered] Downsell Offers: to turn a “no” into a “yes”  (even more sales)

[List id 140, level 0; label not rendered] Continuity Offers: to keep them buying again and again
It took me years to realize this - but every super successful business I’ve owned had all four parts perfectly sequenced. The ones that didn’t, weren’t super successful, and they were like most businesses…
Most businesses putter along with only 1 or 2 parts - but - the magic happens when you combine all the parts together.

With a properly designed Money Model…your business attracts the maximum amount of customers, maximizes profit and cash flow so you can outspend the competition, and builds stability in volatile markets with recurring revenue.
And the best part, the Money Models in my new book work for any business, in any industry, of any size. 
I’ve been waiting for 6 years to unleash the insane power of Money Models - and the time has finally come. 
$100M Money Models is coming out on August 16th, 2025.
So if you enjoyed $100M Offers, $100M Leads... or any of my free content, courses, or books I've put out over the last few years, this is definitely for you:

[List id 4, level 0; label not rendered] And if you wanna win absurd prizes, refer friends for free.*

PPS - Remember, to get my Secret Giveaway you have to:
1) Register 2) Show up live. That’s it.

search_text: All while…hopping on and off meetings, endless notifications, new emails, phone calls, sales meetings, personnel issues…the list goes on forever.

search_text: It makes what should be simple, into a near impossible feat. There’s a reason 95% of businesses in the US are <$1M in annual revenue. And only .4% (1 in 250) make it past $10M. And only ~.2% make it over $50M (1 in 500)...it’s hard.

search_text: So no, I have no magic pill for you, but I do have a process that’s helped Leila and I scale our companies (and get some big exits) over the last 13 years. And I’m gonna show you how it works, and how to use it, on one piece of paper.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: How It Works
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: It’s based on a single premise: every business grows until it hits a constraint, then it will grow no further. Once you relieve the constraint, the business grows again until it hits the next constraint.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: Think About It Like This…
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: [Image: word/media/image20.png]
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: Let’s say you have a four-lane highway that narrows down to one lane. What happens? A traffic jam. If you add lanes before the bottleneck, what happens? A bigger traffic jam. What happens if you add lanes after the bottleneck? Traffic still moves at the one-lane speed. In other words, you add potential to the system, but not throughput. This is what most business owners do. They add capacity before or after the bottleneck. They work. But nothing grows.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: The only way to get rid of the traffic jam—aka—scale the business—is to add lanes to the one-lane section. Once you do that, the traffic flows at the “four-lane speed”—think max revenue growth—until you hit the next bottleneck.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: So, the obvious question becomes—how do you make sure what you’re working on is the “one-lane problem” - aka - the constraint?
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: How To Figure Out Your Constraint (Your One-Lane Problem)
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: 1. Ask: “What’s the one thing you do that makes the most money?”
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: 2. Then ask: “What if I just did 50X more of that?”
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: 3. When you say you can’t, ask yourself: “Why not?”
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: →The answer to that question is the constraint that’s limiting the business.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

search_text: Easy To Say, Hard To Do
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: Let’s say “scaling ads” is the thing that would make you money - BUT - the one thing that happens is you are no longer profitable when you scale them. That’s the clear symptom, but the root cause could be: you don’t make enough per customer - or - it costs you too much to get them.
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx

citation.location_basis: Word XML body block; not a printed or converted page number

search_text: To figure out which, you’d look at benchmarks for the industry. Let’s say you find out you’re getting customers for the same price as everyone else…then you’d need to make them worth more: raise prices, decrease churn, add an upsell/cross sell, or some combination of them all. Alternatively, let’s say you find it’s costing you too much to get customers. Then you’d need to: fix targeting, make more ads, make better ads, split test your offer/lead magnet, optimize your click journey for your customers…or some combination. That’s a lot. So, where do you start?
source_path: $HORMOZI_SOURCE_ROOT/$100m Money Models Book launch/(Blackbook) $100M Money Models - Master Doc.docx
